item.title: Bulletin updated at 04:55 HKT 30/Sep/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An easterly airstream will continue to affect the coast of Guangdong today and tomorrow. Meanwhile, a broad trough of low pressure will bring showers to the central and northern parts of the South China Sea. An anticyclone aloft is expected to strengthen gradually early next week. It will become fine and hot over southern China. The northeast monsoon will affect the coast of southern China in the middle and latter parts of next week. It will be windy over the region. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Roke will move across the seas south of Japan in the next couple of days.
